# CLI-062 pending-save regression

`cli062-pending-razzle.json` was generated against commit
`3d8b14e33abdd92f9a4d213cd02810c4f81c6b46`, before the CLI-062 fix.
It uses `tests.synthetic_teams.default_teams()` with season 2002 and replaces
every Play 2 offensive cell with a synthetic no-change, out-of-bounds cell from
`tests.test_models.provenance()`. The fictional team IDs are
`2002/alpha-tech` and `2002/beta-state`; gameplay seed is 7 and coach seed is 31.
The only executed command is `snap RZDZ A`, leaving the game at a required
Razzle-Dazzle decision with the original bare-asterisk labels in its view digest.

The fixture is an authentic earlier serialization, not regenerated by the
implementation under test. Its loading and continuation test reconstructs the
same synthetic charts and requires unchanged strict replay checks. It contains
no historical charts, roster names or owner game data.
